about: Chat 9 round F (chat 8 Oct 29 11:00 AM, Brandon 10:42 'nothing is written off'): the HARD kinds, 3 sample parks each (NV markers: US-13274, US-13275, US-13276; BLM airstrips: US-13494, US-13496, US-13497; scenic road areas: US-13207, US-13259, US-13260; fish hatcheries: US-10815, US-12976, US-12994; state historic sites ND: US-12782, US-12783, US-12784; state historic sites OK: US-0822, US-0872, US-10951; BLM historic/interpretive: US-10965, US-11110, US-11118; state fishing lakes: US-12193, US-12194, US-12195). Leads in order: (1) agency property layer, (2) federal surface-ownership at the pin, (3) county parcels with the agency as owner; record which answered. Results: roundF-tested.json.
